items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And I went to John Hammond and told him about it. John gave me two weeks' money.

ctx.x: Benny didn't say anything. They had a record date coming up in the next couple of days. He hired Jo Jones. Now, he fired me without notice, but -- mind you. And I went to John Hammond and told him about it. John gave me two weeks' money. Well, now, since when did Benny do something without saying something to him about it?

So he went out the next night, after he fired me, they were up on the mezzanine, fighting like two women. Hands in front of their face and striking out with the other. That was funny. John Hammond, brother-in-laws.
